caption:
बॉक्स ऑफिस पर Ramayana का जलवा कायम है और फिल्म ने एक नया इतिहास रच दिया है! 💥

16th day यानी तीसरे Friday को इस फिल्म के Hindi कलेक्शन में गिरावट दर्ज की गई।
Day 15 के 18.1 crore के मुकाबले Day 16 पर फिल्म ने 11.25 crore की कमाई की, जो 37.84% का drop है।
लेकिन इस कमाई के साथ ही Ramayana ने India net box office पर 703.33 crore का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है, जो gross में 829.93 crore होता है। 🚀
इसके साथ ही यह फिल्म 700 crore net club में एंट्री करने वाली इतिहास की चौथी Hindi film बन गई है!
इससे पहले सिर्फ Pushpa 2, Dhurandhar और Dhurandhar 2 ही इस खास क्लब में जगह बना पाई थीं। 🎬
Nitesh Tiwari के डायरेक्शन और Namit Malhotra व Yash के प्रोडक्शन में बनी 5 November 2026 को रिलीज़ हुई इस फिल्म में Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta और Vivek Oberoi जैसे कलाकार मौजूद हैं। 🔥

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana अपने तीसरे weekend में 800 crore net का नया टारगेट छू पाएगी? कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Hindi Box Office Day 16: Becomes Only 4th Hindi Film In History To Enter The 700 Crore Club!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana (Hindi) saw a considerable drop at the Indian box office on its third Friday, yet it entered the 700 crore club in net collections. 
 The post  Ramayana Hindi Box Office Day 16: Becomes Only 4th Hindi Film In History To Enter The 700 Crore Club!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The Hindi-dubbed version of Ramayana continues to do well at the Indian box office. Yes, collections are a bit lower than expected, but still, it has fetched a good number. On the third Friday, day 16, the film suffered a noticeable drop, but it still achieved an exciting feat by entering the 700 crore net club. With this, it has become the fourth Hindi film in history to reach the milestone. Keep reading for a detailed report!
The Bollywood magnum opus scored 11.25 crore in Hindi on its third Friday, day 16. Compared to day 15’s 18.1 crore , it showed a 37.84% drop. Overall, the film has earned 703.33 crore net at the Indian box office, which equals 829.93 crore gross. From here, the target of the 800 crore net club is open if the film performs strongly in the third weekend.
On its 16th day, Ramayana (Hindi) crossed the 700 crore net mark at the Indian box office, becoming the fourth film to achieve the feat in Hindi collections. Before this, Pushpa 2 , Dhurandhar, and Dhurandhar 2 entered the 700 crore net club. Also, it is currently the fourth-highest-grossing Hindi film ever in the country.

Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash under the banner of Prime Focus Studios, Monster Mind Creations, and DNEG. It also stars Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Indira Krishnan, Rakul Preet Singh, Sonal Jha, Vivek Oberoi, and others. It was released on November 5, 2026.
